sql.label: Nearest current paragraphs
sql.statement: SELECT v.distance, p.lang, p.page_id, p.para_id, p.section, p.text, p.rev_id, a.title, a.wikidata_id, s.badge, s.badge_label, s.badge_reasons FROM ( SELECT text_hash, VEC_DISTANCE_COSINE(embedding, VEC_FromText(?)) AS distance FROM text_vector WHERE is_current = 1 ORDER BY distance LIMIT 40 ) v JOIN paragraph p ON p.text_hash = v.text_hash AND p.undone = 0 JOIN article a ON a.lang = p.lang AND a.page_id = p.page_id LEFT JOIN paragraph_signal s ON s.lang = p.lang AND s.page_id = p.page_id AND s.para_id = p.para_id ORDER BY v.distance

sql.label: llm cache lookup
sql.statement: SELECT response FROM llm_cache WHERE cache_key = ?

sql.label: llm cache store
sql.statement: INSERT IGNORE INTO llm_cache (cache_key, kind, model, response, created) VALUES (?,?,?,?,UTC_TIMESTAMP())
